## Documentation

- [/documentation/weather-mcp-authentication](/documentation/weather-mcp-authentication.md): The AccuWeather MCP server endpoint and how to authenticate it with your API key, as an Authorization header or an apikey URL parameter.
- [/documentation/unit-types](/documentation/unit-types.md): The unit type IDs and symbols used in AccuWeather API responses, such as feet, inches, miles, kilometers per hour and knots, with their numeric values.
- [/documentation/point-of-interest-types](/documentation/point-of-interest-types.md): The point-of-interest type IDs used by the AccuWeather Locations API, such as amusement parks, aquariums and stadiums, for finding POI location keys.
- [/documentation/minutecast-quick-start](/documentation/minutecast-quick-start.md): Make your first MinuteCast™ API call by requesting a minute-by-minute precipitation forecast for New York City coordinates with your AccuWeather API key.
- [/documentation/locations-info](/documentation/locations-info.md): How the AccuWeather Locations API finds location keys for cities, postal codes, points of interest and coordinates, with notes on aliases and time zones.
- [/documentation/location-keys](/documentation/location-keys.md): What an AccuWeather location key is, how to find one with the Locations API, and how to use it to request forecasts, current conditions and alerts.
- [/documentation/indices](/documentation/indices.md): The full list of AccuWeather daily indices and their IDs, from air quality and arthritis pain to the AccuLumen Brightness Index, for the Indices API.
- [/documentation/glossary](/documentation/glossary.md): Definitions of terms used throughout the AccuWeather API documentation, such as admin codes, location aliases, API keys and tropical basin IDs.
- [/documentation/core-weather-quick-start](/documentation/core-weather-quick-start.md): Make your first Core Weather API call by using a location key for New York City to request a 5-day daily forecast with your AccuWeather API key.
- [/documentation/authentication](/documentation/authentication.md): Get your AccuWeather API key from your dashboard and send it in the Authorization header to authenticate every request to the AccuWeather APIs.
- [/documentation/api-flow-diagram](/documentation/api-flow-diagram.md): Diagrams of the AccuWeather Core Weather and MinuteCast™ API request flows, from looking up a location key to requesting forecasts, indices and alarms.
